presentation.label: CONTROL IN ACTIONS
presentation.summary: A switch mode for EXP/CV IN 1 and 2: a gate or footswitch holds or toggles the MUTE screen, or switches live recording.
presentation.overview: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get a fourth MODE, FSW. Pick what the input does in FOOTSW DEST: MUTE HLD shows the MUTE screen while the input is high and goes back to the mode you were in when it drops, MUTE TGL opens and closes it, LIVE REC turns live recording on and off. A 0 to 5 V gate works as it is; for a footswitch, FOOTSWITCH LEARN reads its two levels. Each jack has its own MODE, so one can switch while the other still plays the kit's CV or expression macro.
highlights: Hands-free mutes with both hands on the pads
Set up in stock's own CONTROL INPUT menus, saved with them
Works with a 0 to 5 V gate or a footswitch
usage: Hold a footswitch (or send a gate), punch mutes on the pads, release to go back to playing.
Tap it to drop into live recording and again to leave it while the pattern plays on.

steps: Connect a gate or footswitch to EXP/CV IN 1 or 2.
Open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 (or 2) and set MODE to FSW.
Set FOOTSW DEST to MUTE HLD, MUTE TGL or LIVE REC.
For a footswitch, run FOOTSWITCH LEARN and press it a few times; if pressing does the opposite, set REVERSE DIRECTION.

limitations: Stay within the jack's -5 V to +5 V.
The input is read about 20 times a second, so an action can come up to about 50 ms after it.
A jack in FSW mode plays no CONTROL IN MOD macro. Without the module, a unit left in FSW mode reads that jack as nothing.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2: MODE FSW and the FOOTSW DEST list
input:EXP/CV IN 1 and 2 in FSW mode

load.conditions: UI only: two readings each UI tick, never in the audio path.
